잠언-24-1.title: 잠언 24장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-24-1.exegesis: 26-35. A solemn warning against whoredom and drunkenness ( Ho 4:11 ). give me-- This is the address of that divine wisdom so often presented ( Pr 8:1 ; 9:3 , &c.). heart-- confidence. observe-- keep. my ways-- such as I teach you ( Pr 3:17 ; 9:6 ).
